description: This source file contains functions for persisting various objects related to log analysis, including uploads, analysis runs, findings, and structured reports. It interacts with a database via SQLAlchemy ORM models and handles file storage and metadata management.

methods.name: str _sha256_bytes(data: bytes)
methods.description: Computes the SHA256 hash of given byte data.

methods.name: Upload persist_upload( db: Session, *, file: UploadFile, raw_bytes: bytes, source_system: str | None, environment: str | None, metadata: dict[str, Any] | None, )
methods.description: Persists an uploaded file and saves its metadata to the database.

methods.name: AnalysisRun create_run(db: Session, *, upload_id: uuid.UUID, parser_name: str, parameters: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new analysis run record in the database.

methods.name: None mark_run_succeeded(db: Session, *, run_id: uuid.UUID, summary: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Marks an analysis run as successful and updates its summary.

methods.name: None mark_run_failed(db: Session, *, run_id: uuid.UUID, error_message: str)
methods.description: Marks an analysis run as failed with an error message.

methods.name: None persist_findings(db: Session, *, upload_id: uuid.UUID, run_id: uuid.UUID, findings: list[dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Persists a list of findings related to a run/upload into the database.

methods.name: StructuredReport persist_structured_report( db: Session, *, upload_id: uuid.UUID, run_id: uuid.UUID, report: dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Stores the final structured report associated with a run and upload.
